title: Erasmus
summary: Raleigh names Erasmus in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Erasmus deuised the fable of our Ladies letters, and later held that Ioash was deriued from Nathan the sonne of Dauid. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter XX, §. IV, sig. 316b
